name: NoAREA
source:
Two solitudes - doctor and company president secretary - meet at a beautiful bar named NoAREA.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
兩個孤獨者——醫生和公司總裁的秘書——在一家名為NoAREA的美麗酒吧相遇。
